name: @open-game-system/docs
description: OGS developer docs (ogs-docs.pages.dev): how to make a web game OGS-compatible, for people and their coding agents. Every page also as Markdown, plus llms.txt

scripts.preview: tsx src/cli.ts && wrangler pages dev dist --port 5196
scripts.deploy: tsx src/cli.ts && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=ccf4d9a0a3b76ffae0b6ee048de66f07 wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name ogs-docs --branch main
scripts.waitlist:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply ogs-docs-waitlist --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply ogs-docs-waitlist-preview --remote --env preview
scripts.waitlist:stats: wrangler d1 execute ogs-docs-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT COALESCE(v.src,'(none)') AS source, v.views, COALESCE(w.signups,0) AS signups FROM (SELECT COALESCE(utm_source,'(none)') AS src, COUNT(*) AS views FROM visits GROUP BY 1) v LEFT JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(utm_source,'(none)') AS src, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM waitlist GROUP BY 1) w ON w.src = v.src ORDER BY signups DESC, views DESC"
